run_all_evals: run all evaluations including CLM, MLM, and MT tasks on valid and test datasets
evaluate_clm: evaluate causal language model perplexity and next-word prediction accuracy
evaluate_mlm: evaluate masked language model perplexity and masked-word prediction accuracy
evaluate_mt: evaluate machine translation perplexity, accuracy, and BLEU scores with back-translation
eval_memory_usage: evaluate memory slot usage statistics including KL divergence, Gini coefficient, and top-k coverage
